request.task: T3C1B closure for Workbench current-run Agent Studio retention and inactive accessibility boundary
request.head: 899b39433c4be242b4b3adcd39f3e6cd53df99c0

audit.proof_assessment: Integrated Workbench (page key={id}) remounts the hasOpenedAgentStudio latch on run change; the page only mounts Workbench after restore, so the initializer sees the restored activeTool. After open (click or assistant on mount), shouldRenderAgentStudio stays true across tool and View/Edit changes and renders a single AgentStudioPanel keyed by runId. Visibility is assistant∧edit; otherwise the retained wrapper uses native hidden, aria-hidden, and inert. panelContent returns Editing paused for all tools in view and null for assistant in edit, so it does not mount a second panel. Collapse still unmounts the section (unclaimed). The source test binds the listed strings/regex only; it does not execute the latch, count trees, or prove 0x0/tab/continuity (those are delegated to E2E).
residual_risks: Substring oracles stay green if a second <AgentStudioPanel is added or if hasOpenedAgentStudio is removed while wrapper/inert/key strings remain.
props.mode === "view" is not uniquely bound to agentStudioInactive, so dropping mode from the inactive predicate would still pass.
Collapse unmounts the retained tree and resets AgentStudioPanel instance state; explicitly unclaimed.
inert/hidden apply only to the wrapper subtree; portal UI from AgentStudioPanel (not in this slice) would not inherit that boundary.
